scenes.description: 退潮后的悬崖底部露出一个低矮的洞口。洞壁上刻满了和石板一样的符号，但在这里它们是活的——随潮水声脉动，发出微弱的绿光。地上散落着鱼骨和被海水泡烂的仪式袍。
scenes.image_prompt: low cave entrance at cliff base during low tide, walls covered in glowing symbols pulsing with green light, scattered fish bones and waterlogged robes, Ink Frenzy style, oceanic horror, dark tunnel leading deeper

scenes.description: 洞穴深处是一个天然的圆形空间，海水在下方形成一个漆黑的池子。池边摆着六支黑蜡烛和一把祭祀刀。池水突然泛起涟漪——从中央浮上来一块巨大的石板，比你们见过的任何一块都完整，上面刻着一幅完整的星图和一条不该存在于地球海洋中的海岸线。
scenes.image_prompt: natural round cave chamber, black pool at center rippling as huge stone slab emerges, complete star map and impossible coastline carved on surface, black candles around pool edge, Ink Frenzy style, cosmic horror reveal, breathtaking and terrifying

exit_labels.temple_ruins::underwater_approach: 石板指向更深处的水下通道
exit_labels.cliffside_path::summit: 退出洞穴从悬崖上方寻找答案
